lines.text: David says his heart is steadfast, and he calls the harp and lyre to awake so he can awaken the dawn.
David will praise the LORD among the nations, because God's loving devotion extends beyond the heavens.
David prays that God's glory will cover all the earth and that God will save His people with His left hand.
God says from His sanctuary that He will triumph, and He declares that Moab is His washbasin and upon Ammon He tosses His sandal.
David asks who will lead him to Edom, asks God for aid against the enemy, and says God will trample their enemies.
